notice: Example values, not live market prices.
sources: Sea distances: great-circle legs between standard sea-lane waypoints (traffic separation schemes, capes, straits, canal ends), computed by OBM Shipping and rounded to 5 nm; on benchmark lanes they agree with commonly quoted port-to-port distances within about 2%. Where a charter party names a distance, use that. ECA share: the part of each route inside SOx Emission Control Areas (the Mediterranean from 1 May 2025, the North Sea and English Channel, North America). Port and passage costs are for an Aframax-size ship; each class scales them by its size factor.

ports.name: Novorossiysk
ports.note: Russian port: price-cap and sanctions rules apply to the cargo and the voyage. Every fixture is screened before an offer.

ports.name: CPC Terminal (Novorossiysk)
ports.note: CPC Blend is Kazakh-origin crude loaded in Russia: origin documents are checked before fixing.

ports.name: Tuapse
ports.note: Russian port: price-cap and sanctions rules apply to the cargo and the voyage. Every fixture is screened before an offer.

ports.name: Sidi Kerir (SUMED)
ports.note: Mediterranean end of the SUMED pipeline.

ports.name: Gibraltar
ports.note: Outside the EU for the EU ETS.

ports.name: Ain Sukhna (SUMED)
ports.note: Red Sea end of the SUMED pipeline, where laden VLCCs too deep for Suez discharge or lighten.

ports.name: Ras Tanura
ports.note: Inside the Strait of Hormuz, where transits have been disrupted since March 2026: check war-risk cover and timing with the desk.

passages.name: Turkish Straits (Bosphorus and Dardanelles)
passages.note: Light dues, pilotage, tugs and agency for a full transit; large laden tankers transit one way in daylight, so waiting is common.

passages.name: Bosphorus
passages.note: Between the Black Sea and Sea of Marmara ports.

passages.name: Dardanelles
passages.note: Between the Aegean and Sea of Marmara ports.

passages.name: Suez Canal
passages.note: Canal dues, agency, tugs and convoy waiting. Laden VLCCs are too deep: they lighten through SUMED or sail round the Cape.

passages.name: Panama Canal
passages.note: Neopanamax locks: tolls and agency. Slot auctions in congested periods come on top.

passages.name: Strait of Gibraltar
passages.note: No dues; listed for the route.

passages.name: Bab el-Mandeb
passages.note: War-risk area: enter the additional war-risk premium quoted for the voyage as the cost.

passages.name: Strait of Hormuz
passages.note: War-risk area: enter the additional war-risk premium quoted for the voyage as the cost.
